description: This file defines a Java interface for namespace persistence operations within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies a method to purge a namespace from storage, returning an Akka stream source of errors encountered during the operation.

classes.name: NamespacePersistenceOperations
classes.description: An interface defining persistence operations related to namespaces, currently supporting a purge operation.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Purges a namespace from persistent storage, returning a Source stream that emits a list of Throwables representing errors encountered during the operation.
